liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (3 reviews): Crowd showed a special moment of appreciation after the song; reviewer says Billy sang it with heart and soul; The audience reaction after the song was priceless, a moment reviewer thinks must be special for a musician [10][11][12]
- **Dust in a Baggie** (1 review): The song included a tease of Playin' in the Band [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **I’ll Remember You Love in My Dreams**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Jerry’s Breakdown**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Willin**: rare: 5 archived performances [14]
- **Wharf Rat**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 10 archived performances [14]
- **She Makes My Love Come Rolling Down**: rare: 14 archived performances [14]
- **Wild Horses**: rare: 11 archived performances [14]
- **If Your Hair’s Too Long, There’s Sin in Your Heart**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.neumannKM150.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says every recording of this night sounds good, so any source works [10]
- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.akg414.flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the AKG 414 recording the best capture of this show [13]
- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 163 min [3]
- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 164 min [4]

## Around the show

- The band teased Playin' in the Band twice; reviewer hoped for a full version and thinks the Capitol would have erupted [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.neumannKM150.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Neumann KM150's>Sound Devices MixPre-10II [1]. Also: Processed in Sound Forge Pro 13 with fades, resampling and POW-r conversion to 16-bit/44.1kHz, tracked in CDWAV, FLAC via Trader's Little Helper [1]
- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.akg414.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: AKG 414 XLS'>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II [2]. Also: Keith Litzenberger recorded with hypercardioid AKG C414 XLS mics into a Sound Devices MixPre-10 II at 32-bit float, 48kHz; Sound Forge Pro 13 handled fades and POW-r conversion to 24-bit/48kHz; then CDWAV tracking, Trader's Little Helper FLAC, Foobar2000 tagging [2]
- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>KCY250/5i>VST62iu>SD MixPre-10 II [3]. Also: Sound Forge Pro 13 handled fades and POW-r conversion to 24-bit/48kHz; then CDWAV tracking, FLAC encoding, Foobar2000 tagging [3]
- **billystrings2020-01-18.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>KCY250/5i>VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II [4]. Also: Sound Forge Pro 13 handled fades, resampling and POW-r conversion to 16-bit/44.1kHz; then CDWAV tracking and Trader's Little Helper FLAC [4]
